name: EMCC
recent: EMCC 最新季度（截至2026年9月30日）净利按年增长，当季净利报1,390万令吉；首九个月净利达4,150万令吉，已超越2025财年全年盈利。公司于10月获得四张典当执照，进军东马市场。此外，公司因员工行使ESOS期权而发行新股。
notable: 获得四张典当执照，进军东马市场。
首九个月净利达4,150万令吉，超越2025财年全年盈利。
因员工行使ESOS期权，发行约101万股新股。
risks: 首席执行官行使ESOS期权，涉及289,800股。
ESOS期权行使导致股本逐步扩大。
earnings: 最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收为5,949万令吉，按季下降12.0%，按年增长21.9%；净利为1,386.5万令吉，按季增长1.1%，按年增长49.6%；净利率为23.3%，高于上一季度的20.3%。

recent_en: EMCC's latest quarter (ended 30 Sep 2026) saw year-on-year net profit growth, with quarterly net profit at RM13.9 million; 9M26 net profit reached RM41.5 million, surpassing FY25 full-year earnings. In October, the company secured four pawnbroking licences to expand into East Malaysia. Separately, new shares were issued following the exercise of ESOS options.
notable_en: Secured four pawnbroking licences to expand into East Malaysia.
9M26 net profit reached RM41.5 million, surpassing FY25 full-year earnings.
Issued approximately 1.01 million new shares following the exercise of ESOS options.
risks_en: CEO exercised ESOS options involving 289,800 shares.
Exercise of ESOS options leads to gradual share capital expansion.
earnings_en: Latest quarter (ended 30 Jun 2026) revenue was RM59.49 million, down 12.0% QoQ but up 21.9% YoY; net income was RM13.865 million, up 1.1% QoQ and 49.6% YoY; net margin was 23.3%, higher than 20.3% in the previous quarter.
